description: Toronto Shelter System Flow is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The City of Toronto funds and operates services dedicated to people experiencing homelessness in Toronto. The overnight services, including emergency shelters, respites, and other allied services (including hotel/motel programs and warming centres), use the Shelter Management Information System (SMIS) to intake people who are accessing these services into their programs. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are affordable housing, homeless, intake, shelters. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
